scenarios.name: Hero Section Rendering
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons (REQ-1)

steps.description: Open the application root URL (/) in a browser
steps.context: User is not authenticated, visiting the public homepage

steps.description: Check that headline, subheadline, primary CTA, and secondary CTA are visible
steps.context: Hero section should be the first visible content above the fold

steps.description: Click primary CTA ('Get Started Free') and verify navigation to /register
steps.context: CTA should guide users toward registration

test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 element with compelling headline text
Subheadline paragraph explaining value proposition is visible

test_cases.input: Render Home component with FuturisticButton components
test_cases.expected: Primary CTA button with 'Get Started Free' text is rendered
Navigation occurs to /register route
Smooth scroll to features section or navigation to appropriate section

steps.description: Open the application root URL (/) in a browser
Scroll down to view the features section
steps.context: Features section should be visible after hero

steps.description: Confirm 3-4 feature cards are displayed with icons and descriptions
steps.context: Features: URL Shortening, Analytics Dashboard, Geographic Insights, Share & Collaborate

test_cases.expected: At least 3 GlassMorphismCard components are rendered
URL Shortening feature card with appropriate icon and description is displayed
Analytics Dashboard feature card with chart/stats icon is displayed
Geographic Insights feature card with location/globe icon is displayed
Each feature card has a title, description, and visual icon element

steps.description: Click Login button and verify navigation to /login
steps.context: User should be redirected to login page

steps.description: Return to homepage and click Register button, verify navigation to /register
steps.context: User should be redirected to registration page

test_cases.expected: Login button/link is visible in navigation
Register/Sign Up button/link is visible in navigation
User is navigated to /login route
User is navigated to /register route
User is navigated to / (homepage) or page scrolls to top

scenarios.name: WCAG Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards (NFR-3)

steps.description: Use axe-core or similar tool to audit homepage
Navigate entire page using only keyboard (Tab, Enter, Escape)
steps.context: All interactive elements must be reachable

steps.description: Check that focus states are visible on all interactive elements
Verify text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text

test_cases.input: Run axe-core accessibility audit on homepage
test_cases.expected: No critical or serious accessibility violations
All buttons, links, and inputs are keyboard accessible
All images have appropriate alt text attributes
Page has proper h1 > h2 > h3 heading structure
Skip link is present for keyboard users
Page content is announced correctly and logically
